sloka: अध्रुवे हि शरीरे यो न करोति तपोर्जनम् ।स पश्चात्तप्यते मूढो मृतो दृष्ट्वा ऽ ऽत्मनो गतिम् ।। ७.१५.२२ ॥
transliteration: adhruve hi śarīre yo na karoti taporjanam ।sa paścāttapyate mūḍho mṛto dṛṣṭvā ' 'tmano gatim ।। 7.15.22 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the foolish person who does not accumulate merit through penance in this impermanent body will repent later, after death, upon seeing their own ultimate destination.
